item.title: Threats, violence, and intimidation: 262 incidents reported against journalists in 2025
item.description: For the third consecutive year, journalists have filed more incident reports while on the job.

item.title: Video: group of men attack woman in her car in Helmond
item.description: Video footage has surfaced on social media showing a group of 11 men attacking a woman in her car in Helmond. The incident occurred at 1:30 p.m.

item.title: Volendam commemorates 14 lives lost in New Year's café fire
item.description: Volendam marked the 25th anniversary on Thursday of the café ’t Hemeltje fire, which broke out on New Year’s night in 2001. 14 young people were killed, and more than 200 were injured.

item.title: New Year’s damage claims rise as more fires reported across the Netherlands
item.description: Damage reports related to New Year’s celebrations are gradually rising.

item.title: New Year’s Eve sees mobile data spike, number of calls and texts drop

item.title: Syrian asylum seekers identified as teens murdered in Amsterdam park; No arrests yet
item.description: The two teenagers shot and killed in an Amsterdam park late on New Year's Day were both identified as Syrians seeking asylum in the Netherlands.

item.title: Two arrested in Bedum over New Year’s fire that destroyed sports hall
item.description: Two suspects were arrested in Bedum, Groningen, on Friday for alleged involvement in the fire that razed the De Vlijt sports hall on New Year’s night.

item.title: Dutch industrial growth slows slightly in December, but confidence remains high
item.description: Dutch industrial activity grew slightly less in December compared with November, according to the Dutch Association for Purchasing Management (Nevi), which tracks monthly industrial performance.

item.title: Thousands of Dutch amateur weather stations help KNMI boost forecast accuracy
